title: Concept: MD5 use via Insecure.MD5.hash (swift) — review required
description: In swift, Insecure.MD5.hash computes MD5. Collision attacks let an attacker forge a second input with the same digest, which defeats signatures and integrity checks while leaving non-security checksums unaffected. The swift-specific remedy is SHA256.hash.
applicability: swift codebases hashing data through Insecure.MD5.hash; single-line lexical scope.
risk: Forged integrity values and signatures when MD5 protects untrusted data; LOW severity as a default because checksum uses dominate, raised on review when the digest is security-relevant.
